audit.whatIsWrong: The stored chart gave Renekton six of seven rows including level 6, first item and two items, and rated the lane FAV 4/10.
audit.why: packet.levelChart = [Renekton, Renekton, Renekton, Skill, Cho'Gath, Cho'Gath, Skill], and the mirror audit has already rebuilt Cho'Gath's side to exactly that chart with diff EVEN and diffRating 6.5/10. Leaving this side alone would put four rows and the difficulty rating in direct contradiction between the two pages. The page's own whys[5] and whys[6] already concede the post-item game.
audit.corrected: phases[3..6].side flipped with win[3..6] as one atomic group, ratings adjusted, diff set to EVEN and diffRating to 6.5/10 to match the mirror, and breakdown.difficulty / report[2] / report[14] reworded to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as Renekton's ceiling — 'his R true damage cannot swing this all-in while you have the HP buffer' — with no cooldown on either ultimate.
audit.why: Feast is 80/70/60s and deals true damage that scales on his stacks; an HP buffer is exactly the wrong answer to true damage, and at 80s it is up far more often than Dominus at 120s. Rupture is 6s flat, which is the number that actually governs when you may step up.
audit.corrected: whys[4], spikes[1].text and phases[4].why now state the 80s timer and that Dominus HP does not answer true damage; phases[3].why and phases[5].why carry Rupture's 6s.
sources: enemyKit R cd and trueDamage flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Feral Scream's silence is named in three places as a thing to avoid but never given a cooldown, and dontsFull[1].d under the title 'Get silenced mid-cast' was generic filler about spending your own cooldown.
audit.why: Feral Scream is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s and silences in a cone at 300 range — it is the ability that strands Renekton mid-combo with no Q heal and no exit dash, which is the losing pattern in this lane.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d now gives the 11s rank-1 figure and what it costs you.
sources: enemyKit W cd and silence flag

audit.why: The 'angle your dash to arrive at his side so Rupture misses' advice in 'early' is concrete, correct against a telegraphed ground-target ability, and is the best line on the page. Left as written.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Rupture's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Rupture is live every 6 seconds and Feral Scream silences your Q heal — trade only in the beat after the knockup misses.

edits.before: Dominus stats turn even fights into wins before 25 minutes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Cho'Gath's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Feast is true damage on an 80s timer, and Dominus HP does not answer it. Commit only once Rupture has already missed.

edits.before: Eclipse is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Rupture's cooldown.
edits.after: His tank item outgrows your Eclipse burst — trade only on Rupture's 6s cooldown.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Cho'Gath carry threat 6/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Feast stacks blunt your burst but you still split faster. Cho'Gath carry threat 6/10 — pressure the side lane, don't duel.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Rupture and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Rupture and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Yours from level 1. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.
edits.after: Yours early, his after 6. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.

edits.before: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Cho'Gath carry threat 6/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 6.5/10, Cho'Gath carry threat 6/10.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Feral Scream is 11s at rank 1 and can strand you mid-combo.

edits.before: Dominus absorbs his Q+W burst and accelerates your Fury for back-to-back empowered Ws; his R true damage cannot swing this all-in while you have the HP buffer.
edits.after: Feast is true damage on an 80s timer and Rupture knocks you out of your own combo — Dominus buys HP but he picks when the fight happens, so wait for Rupture to miss.

edits.before: Dominus gives you enough HP buffer to absorb his Q+W combo and still run the all-in; his R on a full-HP Renekton barely matters yet.
edits.after: Dominus gives you an HP buffer, but Feast is 80s at rank 1 and deals true damage — pop R only after Rupture has missed, never into it.

notes: Cho'Gath's Rupture carries a derived 'grounding' flag that Riot's description does not support — the text is knockup, damage and slow only, with no movement-ability lockout. No grounding claim was made, and the existing 'dash to his side so Rupture misses' advice does not depend on one. The empowered Ruthless Predator shield-destroy is a non-interaction here (Cho'Gath has no shield); the mirror audit reached the same conclusion and neither side asserts it. diff and diffRating were moved to EVEN / 6.5/10 to match the values the mirror audit already set, so the two pages agree on the headline rating as well as the chart.
